source.note: Traditional vocabulary, Pinyin, POS, and available Context fields come directly from the uploaded workbook; surrounding whitespace is trimmed only.

simplified.note: This is a character-script conversion of the same TOCFL/Taiwan vocabulary, not a Mainland lexical substitution.

bandMapping.note: The workbook itself is organized by levels. This package groups those levels for the website's Band navigation without changing the official level assignment.

bands.coverageNoteVi: File nguồn này chỉ có Level 5 cho nhóm Band C; không tự tạo thêm Level 6.

sourceCountCaveat.note: The workbook comparison sheet named 'Sheet1' shows 233 for Novice 2, but the actual Novice 2 vocabulary sheet contains 234 entries and the dedicated '各等詞條數(Entry Number)' sheet also states 234. This package uses 234.

supplemental.purpose: Reference/search aliases only; never replace the official TOCFL vocabulary term automatically.
supplemental.sourceNoteZh: 此表僅提供「兩岸用語」參照。華語文能力測驗試題設計參照為〈華語八千詞表〉、〈國教院字詞表〉，不因提供簡體版測驗版本，而更動詞彙用語。
